info.title: Beyond Cloud Brand Intelligence API
info.description:
REST API of the **Beyond Cloud Brand Intelligence Automation Platform**.

Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Requirement IDs (e.g. DSH-07) refer to `docs/requirements/01-requirements-register.md`.

Response List Allow Api V1 Brands  Brand Id  Allowlist Get

AlertOut.title: AlertOut
AlertOut.description:
An alert record (why and when it was raised) with its finding's current state (RDA-13).
`status` is the finding's current analyst decision.

FindingDecision.title: FindingDecision
FindingDecision.description: Analyst decision on a finding (RDA-11, D-35). "Reopened" is a timeline event, not a state.

FindingOut.title: FindingOut
FindingOut.description: One entity (SP2): current state + the analyst decision.

FindingStage.title: FindingStage
FindingStage.description: Candidate = discovered, weak; Finding = analysed with evidence (RDA-12, D-33).

StatusChangeIn.title: StatusChangeIn
StatusChangeIn.description: Set the finding's analyst decision (D-35). A note is required for False Positive, Legitimate and Ignored.
